prompt: A household wants to waste less food. Their plan is 'buy less', but they shop hungry once a week with no list, overbuy perishables, and throw food away every Friday. What is the best first fix?

options.text: Feel more guilty each Friday when food is thrown away
Buy a bigger fridge so more food can be stored
Stop buying any perishable food at all
Plan a few meals first and shop from a list, so purchases match what will actually be eaten

explanation: The waste is produced at the buying step, not the throwing-away step. A short meal plan and list target the decision that creates the surplus, which 'buy less' as a vague intention never reaches.
